p28 - 'This week' content opens and plays, by type
Description:
Exercise every content type the current week offers.

        'This week' renders its items flat, with no accordion. Each type has a
        different navigation style, and each is driven the way a participant
        would drive it:

        * video    - opens a modal overlay; play, toggle fullscreen, close
        * handout  - opens the PDF in a new browser tab; verify, then close
        * podcast  - navigates to a player route; played, paused, resumed

        Counts are read from the page rather than assumed, so whatever the
        current week happens to hold is what gets exercised. If a type is
        absent the loop simply does not run - the remaining types are still
        covered, which is the "click whatever is available" behaviour.

        Note the deliberate avoidance of the 'This week' tab: opening a
        course already lands on its current-week view, and the tab's href
        lags a course switch, so clicking it can land on the wrong course.

        An empty current week is a *pass*, not a skip. The week schedule is
        shared test data that rolls over on its own, so "nothing is due
        today" is normal behaviour rather than a gap in coverage, and a
        skipped result in the report invites someone to go looking for a
        problem that does not exist. The empty case is still fully asserted
        before returning - see `assert_empty_state_everywhere()` - so the
        test never passes merely by doing nothing.
